audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Darius/Darius/Skill/Darius/Skill/Darius/Darius — they hand Darius levels 1 and 2 outright. The content whys directly beneath say the opposite: whys[0] 'Level 1 Pantheon's Comet Spear poke and passive block beat your walk-ups', whys[1] 'Level 2 his Shield Vault stun all-in front-loads the lane in his favor'. content early agrees: 'Pantheon owns the first two levels'. The packet levelChart is Pantheon, Pantheon, then Darius x5.
audit.why: Comet Spear reaches 575 against your melee range and Shield Vault is a 13s leap-stun at 600 — before Apprehend exists at level 2-3 there is no answer to either. The 53.59% headline over 2,323 games is earned from level 3 onward, not at level 1.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Pantheon, Pantheon, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius on both layers as one atomic group, with phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten so the Level 1 and Level 2 rows stop claiming Darius wins them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is described as 'his E blocks your autos' and 'his active shield wall'. The page never states the actual restriction, and it never states the passive on your own E.
audit.why: Riot: Aegis Assault means Pantheon is 'invulnerable to damage from THE FRONT' — it is directional, so walking behind him beats a 22s cooldown for free. And Riot's Apprehend text has a passive the Darius page never mentions: it 'passively caus[es] his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor'. Together those are why you do not need to out-wait Aegis Assault at all: pull him out of the channel, and your physical damage is already shredding through what is left.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, breakdown.early, dontsFull[1], phases[2].why and content mid now state the front-only invulnerability, the pull-out-of-channel answer, and Apprehend's armour shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grand Starfall's cooldown appears nowhere, and phases[4].why — the Level 6 row — is generic Guillotine boilerplate carrying raw LaTeX ('R = d + a \times Stacks').
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range. At 180 seconds it is by far the longest cooldown in the matchup and it is a map tool, not a duel button — which is exactly the argument for why Level 6 belongs to Darius. Giving the number turns 'it's a roam ult' from an opinion into a fact the reader can plan a dive around.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, content spikes[1], whys[4] and wants.foe[2] now carry the 180s figure; the LaTeX fragment is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns names Shield Vault as matchup-defining and then gives no number for it or anything else, and breakdown.early tells you to 'Survive levels 1-6' — which contradicts a chart that hands you Level 3 onward.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1, Aegis Assault 22s, Comet Spear 11s, Grand Starfall 180s, and your own Apprehend 26s. The instruction that follows from those numbers is specific: step in once the 13s Shield Vault is spent, and do not spend anything trying to out-wait a 22s Aegis Assault you can simply walk behind.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with all five numbers, breakdown.early re-scoped to 'survive to 3', and dosFull[0] keyed to Shield Vault's 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is never mentioned, so the page gives no tell for when his burst actually starts.
audit.why: Shield Vault carries the autoReset flag: his combo opens on an attack wind-up rather than on a visible cast, so the moment to step out is the swing, not the dash.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and breakdown.cooldowns now name the reset as the tell.

notes: MIRROR: audits/top/pantheon__darius.json exists and I reused its findings — Aegis Assault 22s, Shield Vault 13s, Apprehend 26s as the longest cooldown in the lane, Decimate healing only off the blade, Hemorrhage's five stacks ENRAGING Darius for massive AD rather than empowering his Q, and Apprehend's passive percentage armour shred. Both pages now say the same things. ONE DISAGREEMENT, and I believe the mirror is wrong: its audit marks point 2 'correct' and endorses a chart that gives Pantheon zero stages, while its own rewritten prose says 'Shield Vault's leap-stun into Q poke gives you the hardest level 1-2 of any melee' and 'Your level 1 and 2 are far stronger than his'. My side follows the packet levelChart and my own whys, both of which give Pantheon levels 1 and 2. If mirror-fix.js resolves toward the pantheon file, both pages will end up claiming Darius wins a level 1 he does not. Packet suspectName check: 'Use Grand Starfall' in wants.foe[2] is a FALSE POSITIVE — Grand Starfall is the exact Riot name for Pantheon's R. Carried over from the mirror as still-unverified: that Apprehend's pull drags Pantheon out of an Aegis Assault channel rests on Riot's description of a forced pull plus the kit flagging the channel 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', not on tested behaviour. I wrote it because the mirror already ships it and the two sides must not contradict, but it belongs in unverified on both. Also inherited from the mirror and still unaddressed on my side: the Itemization row is a generic armour build, which is weak advice against a champion whose E passively ignores a percentage of armour and whose R is true damage — that needs more room than the length band allows.
